Return the original label Entailment (supported), Contradiction (opposed), or NotMentioned (not settled by the document); do not substitute external law for contractual text. Decide the relation relative to the exact original hypothesis, including its negation, not whether the contract contains a prohibition. The same 17 hypotheses are checked on every document. All original text is present, with zero-based original span markers <SPAN i>...</SPAN i>. For supported/opposed hypotheses cite all original evidence span indices for that decision, including independently operative redundant support and necessary governing language. For NotMentioned return an empty evidence list. Treat conditions and exceptions within scope, and distinguish limited permission from universal permission. Give a short public reason (at most 15 words per hypothesis), then report supplied skill IDs actually used. Skills are fallible reusable inspection procedures, not facts about this NDA or automatic verdicts. All skills are visible together; public hypothesis IDs describe applicability, not hidden context isolation. Do not execute further tools, invent citations or rewrite span indices. Return exactly the supplied JSON schema with all 17 original hypothesis keys. For each emit choice, spans, reason, used_skill_ids in that order. The common schema describes permitted values, not answers about this contract. Evidence candidates are fallible, not mandatory citations; make every final label and evidence decision yourself from the complete original contract. All17 public tasks share the complete source and one-copy published_source_programs library. A question's applicable_published_skills contains ID references to those complete named records, not missing guidance. Read their inspection and the one-copy source_program_query_receipts. SOURCE_LEADS tags before original SPANs identify mechanical query/list hits by skill ID/query index, not labels or proven relevance. Only original contract text is evidence. Preserve original SPAN indices. A different question's skill is not a condition this question must satisfy. Missing skills/empty hits never mean NotMentioned. {"full_contract_with_original_span_markers":"<SPAN 0>NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT</SPAN 0>
<SPAN 1>This Non-disclosure Agreement (“the Agreement”) is entered into by and between The Royal Heraldry Society of Canada (“the Society”) with its head office in Ottawa, Ontario and its member or other authorized person, (“Receiving Party”) </SPAN 1><SPAN 2>________________________________________ </SPAN 2><SPAN 3>located at </SPAN 3><SPAN 4>___________________________________________. </SPAN 4><SPAN 5>The parties agree to enter into a confidential relationship with respect to the improper disclosure (“Improper Disclosure”) of certain confidential information (“Confidential Information”) to which the Receiving Party will have access to upon receiving access to the membership database maintained by the Society.</SPAN 5>
<SPAN 6>1. Definition of Confidential Information. </SPAN 6><SPAN 7>For purposes of this Agreement, “Confidential Information” shall include all information contained in the membership database, such as members’ names, addresses, birthdates, occupations, spouses’ names, email addresses, telephone numbers, etc.</SPAN 7>
<SPAN 8>2. Definition of “Improper Disclosure”. </SPAN 8><SPAN 9>All Confidential Information contained in the membership database may be used by the Receiving Party exclusively for conducting the business of the Society. </SPAN 9><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-definition-form-identification-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 10>Any disclosure of Confidential Information to any person or corporation for any commercial or other purpose not necessary for the conduct of the Society’s business shall be deemed Improper Disclosure.</SPAN 10>
<SPAN 11>3. Obligations of Receiving Party. </SPAN 11><SPAN 12>Receiving Party shall hold and maintain the Confidential Information in strictest confidence for the sole and exclusive purposes of the Society. </SPAN 12><SPAN 13>Receiving Party shall not use any Confidential Information for their own benefit or permit the use of Confidential Information by others for their benefit or to the detriment of the Society or its good name. </SPAN 13><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-return-copy-retention-evidence":[0],"nda-definition-form-identification-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 14>Upon termination of membership, Receiving Party will immediately return to the Society all records, notes and other written, printed or tangible material in its possession, including CDs and DVDs pertaining to Confidential Information. </SPAN 14><SPAN 15>Confidential Information stored electronically in computers or any other electronic devices will be deleted upon membership termination.</SPAN 15>
<SPAN 16>4. Time Period. </SPAN 16><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-survival-continuity-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 17>The nondisclosure provision of this Agreement shall survive the termination of this Agreement and Receiving Party’s duty to hold Confidential Information in confidence shall remain in effect indefinitely.</SPAN 17>
<SPAN 18>5. Penalties. </SPAN 18><SPAN 19>If proven Improper Disclosure shall take place, the Receiving Party’s membership in the Society shall be terminated immediately. </SPAN 19><SPAN 20>Depending on circumstances, there may also be recourse to the courts and criminal or civil action, or both, may be initiated by the Society or by injured parties.</SPAN 20>
<SPAN 21>This Non-disclosure </SPAN 21><SPAN 22>Agreement and each party’s obligations shall be binding on the Receiving Party and the Society. </SPAN 22><SPAN 23>Each party has signed this Agreement through its authorized representative.</SPAN 23>
